BehaviorTree._description: Compatibility adapter for 2F-85 drop subtrees: receives the calibrated bin pose and provides the drop container's pose and interior dimensions used by Gentle Bag, either the whole bin or the left or right paper bag (bag_side). Load Calibrated Scene adds the open bin walls and the paper bags.

Action.message: Calibrated Bag: bag_side must be bin, left or right.

Action.name: BinAndPaperBagDimensions
Action.code: bin_length := 0.4445; bin_width := 0.3175; bin_height := 0.2794; bin_floor_z := bin_center_z - bin_height / 2.0; paper_bag_width := 0.17; paper_bag_height := 0.365; paper_wall := 0.002; paper_bag_cx := bin_length / 2.0 - paper_bag_width / 2.0

Action.name: ContainerIsTheBin
Action.code: bag_length := bin_length; bag_width := bin_width; bag_height := bin_height; bag_floor_z := bin_floor_z; container_dx := 0.0; container_dz := 0.0

Action.name: ContainerIsTheLeftBag
Action.code: bag_length := paper_bag_width - 2.0 * paper_wall; bag_width := bin_width - 2.0 * paper_wall; bag_height := paper_bag_height; bag_floor_z := bin_floor_z; container_dx := paper_bag_cx; container_dz := paper_bag_height / 2.0 - bin_height / 2.0

Action.name: ContainerIsTheRightBag
Action.code: bag_length := paper_bag_width - 2.0 * paper_wall; bag_width := bin_width - 2.0 * paper_wall; bag_height := paper_bag_height; bag_floor_z := bin_floor_z; container_dx := 0.0 - paper_bag_cx; container_dz := paper_bag_height / 2.0 - bin_height / 2.0

Action.name: ContainerOffset
Action.code: cdx_s := container_dx .. ''; cdz_s := container_dz .. ''; container_offset_xyz := cdx_s .. ';0;' .. cdz_s

SubTree.input_port: The drop container: bin (the whole bin), left or right (one paper bag, as seen from the robot; left is world +X).
SubTree.output_port: Drop container centre in world: world-aligned, centred on its interior, halfway up its walls. Follows the touched outer front-left rim corner of the bin.
Container interior width along world X, in metres.
Container interior depth along world Y, in metres.
Container wall height above the table, in metres.
World z of the container floor (the tabletop).
Bin centre in world, centred between the bin walls, halfway up them. Bin axes are fixed to world X/Y/Z.
Bin interior width along world X, in metres.
Bin interior depth along world Y, in metres.
Bin wall height above the table, in metres.
Outer width of each paper bag along world X, in metres.
Paper bag height above the bin floor, in metres.
Modelled paper wall thickness, in metres.
Distance along world X from the bin centre to each paper bag's centre, in metres.
